svg.title: One potential, two band edges, one charge ledger
svg.desc: Four panels share the finite input domain in nm. Potential is continuous; conduction/valence steps use material offsets. D and E use mid-edge values and corrected one-sided interface limits; vertical jumps mark x=0.

g.text: One potential, two band edges, one charge ledger
Synthetic A/B, 300 K, equilibrium MB; same 1.25 nm data
Material steps are not phi jumps
E also depends on each epsilon
E_F = -0.5 eV. Sheet charge is C/m² at x=0; it is not plotted as volume rho.
